correlated_failures.message: The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process.

classification: Observed host-specific legacy elevated sandbox refresh failure caused by a file-sharing conflict on an existing native runtime ACL target. Installed helpers and completed authenticated model invocations rule out missing helper files or missing model access for these observed attempts.

narrow_recovery_investigation.question: Would disabling an unused inherited Node REPL MCP provider remove the failing ACL target without changing permissions?
narrow_recovery_investigation.result: Not established. Pinned setup source independently gathers platform/profile read roots. Support for disabling an MCP provider does not establish that this runtime target disappears from sandbox refresh.

permitted_recovery: Continue through existing role- and task-scoped VeryThinker MCP operations, preserving the native refusal and actual evidence. This does not establish generic native shell or file-edit compatibility on this host.

sources.scope: Only entries correlated with this project's owned invocations; raw logs are not exported.

limitations: The exact process holding the target executable was not terminated or changed.
No inference is made that all Windows installations or all native edit operations fail.
Scoped MCP operation success is distinct from native sandbox helper success.
Private sandbox secrets and unrelated sessions were not inspected.
